name: Asparagus, Goat Cheese & Lemon Pasta with Pine Nuts & Chives

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
about 21 cups water
3 tbsp salt
510 g (6 ¾ cups) penne pasta

instructions.primary_message: Wash asparagus, snap off woody ends, and cut diagonally into 5 cm pieces. Add to pasta during the final 2-3 minutes of cooking time. Boil until bright green and tender-crisp.
Wash lemons and grate 2 tsp of zest. Wash and chop chives into small pieces.
Heat a small saucepan over medium heat.
Add butter to saucepan and let it melt. Add flour and whisk until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp butter, unsalted
3 tbsp all-purpose flour

instructions.primary_message: Add broth and, stirring constantly, cook until sauce thickens, 2-3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 354 ml (1 ½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Add zest, lemon juice, goat cheese, ½ of the chives (save the rest for garnishing), and salt. Stir until smooth. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
juice of 1 ½ lemon
1 ½ (113 g) log goat cheese
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Drain pasta and asparagus and return to pot.
Add sauce to pasta and toss.
To serve, place pasta in a bowl or on a plate. Garnish with pine nuts, remaining chives, freshly ground pepper, and lemon wedges. Enjoy!
